breaking_news.headline: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
breaking_news.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
breaking_news.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic's shares pop in debut after blockbuster IPO
breaking_news.summary: Shares in the AI juggernaut Anthropic are now trading on the stock market. They debuted Thursday, after a record-breaking IPO.

breaking_news.headline: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

breaking_news.headline: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

breaking_news.headline: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
breaking_news.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
breaking_news.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

breaking_news.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

breaking_news.headline: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
breaking_news.summary: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
breaking_news.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

breaking_news.headline: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
breaking_news.summary: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

breaking_news.headline: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
breaking_news.summary: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

breaking_news.headline: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
breaking_news.summary: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

breaking_news.headline: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
breaking_news.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

breaking_news.headline: GTA 6 sales hit $3.8bn in a single day - the biggest entertainment launch in history
breaking_news.summary: Rockstar Games ended a 13-year wait with what is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch ever.

breaking_news.headline: Airbnb's divisive new house rules come into force
breaking_news.summary: New rules on what Airbnb hosts can reasonably ask guests to do could mean fewer chores but higher costs for customers.

breaking_news.headline: Should AI be judging our credit worthiness?

breaking_news.headline: Tinned food and long-life milk boost retail sales after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
